note: 由 node tools/c-styles.mjs 生成，不要手改；字段含义见 routes/c-style/STYLES.md 的"怎么读这张表"

line.zh: 月亮失眠了，小女孩爬上屋顶给它唱摇篮曲。
line.en: The moon can't sleep, so a little girl climbs onto the roof to sing it a lullaby.

styles.essence: A picture-book page drawn live in wax crayon on toothy paper, with a watercolour wash that reveals what the crayon was hiding.
pitfalls: Gaps between wash bands leave white stripes → overlap bands and cover all intended paper.
Wavy band edges and wide light streaks read as hills → small high-frequency waviness, thin faint streaks (α ≤ 0.12).
Light-pressure colouring goes muddy under a wash → pressure ≥ 0.8 or cross-hatch wherever the wash crosses.

case.title: 小纸船遇上大雨 · 处理方案（Treatment）

line.zh: 跟着降雨从澳洲红色腹地一路画到绿色海岸，一镜到底。
line.en: Follow the rain from Australia's red desert heart to its green coast in one unbroken painted walk.

styles.essence: A hand-painted journal page that paints itself: translucent brush strokes with dry-brush flying white on warm cotton paper, hand-written notes beside what is painted, nothing drawn with a vector line.
pitfalls: Offscreen wash strips too short flatten tall shapes into flat tops and expose seams on tilts → size strips well beyond the frame.
A translucent wash that ends at its canvas edge shows a hard seam under other layers → extend below the frame and fade to paper with a gradient.

Classic scripts share one global scope: touching a `const` before its declaration in async init leaves `READY` false and every screenshot times out → build everything inside the init; read `[pageerror]` lines.

case.title: 一滴颜料变锦鲤

line.zh: 侠客踏水过江，一剑断流。
line.en: A swordsman crosses the river on the water and splits the current with a single stroke.

styles.essence: Xieyi ink painting on rice paper, animated: blank paper is space, one brushstroke is a mountain, a wave, a gesture or a cut.
pitfalls: Dry brush looks like dashed lines → breaks from long-scale noise and an ink load that drops along the stroke.
Parallel semi-transparent strokes make bodies look like organ pipes → one base mass + two loaded strokes.
Big side-brush strokes look like a hairbrush → a gradient mass + a few low-dryness strokes. Gradients in vertical bands leave seams → a cached per-pixel layer.

case.title: 鹤出留白 · 中国水墨风格样片（19.0 s）

line.zh: 灰色雨中广场，第一把红伞撑开，圆舞曲把整个广场刷上颜色。
line.en: In a grey, rainy square one red umbrella opens, and a waltz paints the whole plaza in colour.

styles.essence: Thick oil paint laid with a palette knife: big, flat, sharp-edged planes of colour, raked by light so every ridge of paint shows.
pitfalls: Confined strokes shrink near edges and leave canvas-coloured outlines → add the underpainting texture.
Draw order in the reference matters: painting the ground after the buildings covers their feet.
Plain rectangles read as posts or blocks → give silhouettes taper, a lit edge, and one or two defining dabs (shoulder, hair, handle).

case.title: 红色自行车 · 油画厚涂风格样片（19.5 秒）

line.zh: 一根不离纸的线画完一个人的一生，再把笔交给孩子。
line.en: One unbroken line draws a whole life, then the pen passes to a child.

styles.essence: A single ink line that never leaves the paper.
pitfalls: **Stray connectors ruin a reveal**: every extra line reads as a wrinkle, beard or mask. Fix the topology (where each chapter enters and leaves), not the drawing. Plan it like an Euler path: a closed motif is a circuit (you leave where you came in); retrace or reorder chapters.
Each region of a final picture is drawn exactly once; connectors must fall on natural lines of that picture.
**Test the reveal early and often**: render the whole path at once at final scale after every change.

case.title: 一根线的早晨

line.zh: 手机怎么知道你在哪：GPS、原子钟，和相对论每天多出的 38 微秒。
line.en: How your phone knows where you are: GPS, atomic clocks, and the 38 microseconds relativity adds every day.

styles.essence: An explainer drawn live on one glossy dry-erase board: single-line handwriting that is actually *written* stroke by stroke, floating markers with no hand, magnets that can move, an eraser that can rewind, and a camera that travels across the board instead of cutting.
pitfalls: **One pen, too many jobs** drifts later and later → give each drawing a deadline window and let overlapping jobs go to another pen.
**Minimum stroke duration × many dashes** makes a dashed line take seconds → dashes need their own floor.
**A pooled-ink dot bigger than the stroke start** leaves halos on every letter → keep it inside.

case.title: 天为什么是蓝的 · 白板讲解风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 十日炙烤大地，后羿张弓射日。
line.en: Ten suns scorch the earth until the archer Hou Yi draws his bow, told with leather puppets on a lit screen.

styles.essence: Chinese shadow theatre: translucent dyed-hide puppets, carved like lace, pressed against a cotton screen and lit from behind by oil lamps.
pitfalls: Flat clip-art look → hide texture, denser openwork, deeper dyes, carved outlines everywhere.
Figures unreadable in profile → bigger head, fuller lower body, collar piece, contrasting sleeves.
Radiating shapes read as saw blades or petals → flame tongues with a fat base, belly and hooked tip, alternating curl.

case.title: 渔夫还珠 · 皮影戏风格样片

line.zh: 旅人走向远山，每个镜头都是一幅版画；巨浪是高潮，结尾是远山与整幅画轴拉远。
line.en: A traveller walks toward a distant mountain; every shot is a woodblock print, a great wave at the climax, the mountain and the whole scroll at the end.

styles.essence: Edo-period woodblock prints brought to life: flat colour blocks, carved ink lines, bokashi skies, paper you can feel, and a camera that moves over the print like an unrolling handscroll.
pitfalls: Bokashi from `fillRect` strips leaves vertical seams → build it per pixel.
Too much speckle or fibre makes dark areas look like sandpaper or scratched film → specks α ≈ 0.3, fibres α ≈ 0.09.
A perspective grid for fields looks digital → parallel, slanted, flat layering.

case.title: 一伞三景

line.zh: 除夕年兽进村，小女孩剪出的大窗花照亮全村，把它吓跑。
line.en: On New Year's Eve the beast Nian comes to town, and one girl's giant paper-cut lights up the village to scare it off.

styles.essence: Chinese window-flower paper-cuts brought to life: jointed red cut-outs on paper grounds, where the cut *is* the drawing and the holes are where the light gets in.
pitfalls: **Red on red** reads as one blob → different ground family, near/far paper tones, inset contours for overlaps.
**Darkening a layer through the light map** also darkens what covers it → tint the layer itself (multiply + restore alpha).
**A flat cos-squashed flap reads as a sliding card**, not a fold → strips with fake perspective, darken as it stands up, show the back colour.

case.title: 鲤鱼跃龙门 · 红色窗花剪纸风格样片（19.5 s）

line.zh: 一列老夜车跑最后一趟：从雪山小站穿过长隧道开到海边，到站后车窗一扇扇熄灭。
line.en: An old night train makes its last run, from a snowy mountain halt through a long tunnel to the sea, its lit windows going out one by one at the end of the line.

styles.essence: A layered paper-cut shadow box (纸雕灯) lit from behind: 6–9 sheets of cut card stacked in a shallow box, a warm light glowing through the paper, windows and moons burning through holes, soft shadows falling from each layer onto the next.
pitfalls: `destination-out` cut-outs need an **opaque fillStyle** before punching, or the hole is half-cut (`world.js` `cut(x, fn)` does it).
Soft shadows bleed and halo: layers that must not take part need **both** `shadow: false` and `recv: false`.
A transparent radial-gradient texture shows a square edge as an additive glow → use an analytic shader falloff (`burst()`).

case.title: 夜班火车回家 · 纸雕灯影风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 周日早晨骑车穿过城市：面包店、公园、河边，每到一处加一版油墨，最后三版套印。
line.en: A Sunday-morning bike ride through the city — bakery, park, riverside — each stop adding an ink until three misregistered plates overprint.

styles.essence: Animation that looks printed, frame by frame, on a stencil duplicator: two or three translucent spot inks overprinted on warm paper, halftone dots, ink grain, and plates that never quite line up.
pitfalls: Three halftoned plates in one area = mud → two plates, one tint.
`fract(p*vec2(233.34,851.73))` draws vertical stripes across solids at 1080p → a well-mixed hash (`fract(vec3(p.xyx)*.1031)` family).
Per-frame registration jitter and sheet streaks flicker and blow up file size → fixed offsets per shot, kicks on accents, sheet noise at cuts, partial boil.

case.title: 跳水 · Risograph 孔版印刷 风格样片

line.zh: 橘猫胖橘被立案审查：测试重力、凌晨跑酷，最后无罪释放。
line.en: A chubby orange cat stands trial for testing gravity and 4 a.m. parkour, and walks free.

styles.essence: A retro print case file: cream archive paper, overprinted halftone dots in a few flat inks, huge heavy headlines with misregistered shadows, rubber stamps that slam, and thick-outlined characters.
pitfalls: **Fonts not loaded before layout** → per-character positions computed with a fallback font, glyphs overlap. Preload every family against the whole page source and the built text; runtime strings must use only characters that appear in the file. Use `font-display: block`.
**Boil on text or dots** turns them to mush → filter only characters and props.
**Clip-path ids are global** → every clipped numeral needs a unique id.

case.title: 消失的第十三页

line.zh: 村子用一整个冬天铸一口钟，钟声第一次响起，雪停了。
line.en: A village spends a whole winter casting one bell; the first time it rings, the snow stops.

styles.essence: A relief print that carves itself: every frame is a black wood block, and light only exists where a knife has cut it away.
pitfalls: **White marks on white areas are invisible** → stab cuts need dark masses behind them.
**Hatching every surface looks like fur or rain** → grazing light; 3–6 cuts on the lit edge only.
**Black faces with white cuts don't read small** → skin white, features black, a black keep-line around white parts.

case.title: 灯塔守夜 · 木刻版画风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 一张音乐会海报按瑞士设计的五条规则自己排版，第五条是只打破一条。
line.en: A concert poster lays itself out by five Swiss design rules; the fifth is to break just one.

styles.essence: International Typographic Style in motion: a modular grid, one typeface, one signal colour, and movement as exact as a printing press.
pitfalls: Too many thin columns look like a chart → fewer, wider modules.
A "better" composition that isn't obviously better → one strong diagonal with long/short rhythm, a larger signal element, bleeds, type over colour. Merely tilting is not enough.
Rotating and labelling at once reads as noise → rotate, hold, then add labels.

case.title: TEMPO · 节拍 —— 瑞士动态排版风格样片（19.75 秒）

line.zh: 虚构 1964 年间谍片的片头：追一把被偷的钥匙，几何碎片最后拼成片名。
line.en: Opening titles for an imaginary 1964 spy film: a chase for a stolen key until the shapes lock into the title.

styles.essence: A cut-paper, four-ink opening title sequence for a film that never existed: silhouettes move through sets built out of the credits themselves, every brass stab is a cut, and a title is assembled from the pieces.
pitfalls: Every internal piece outlined with a gap looks like a mannequin diagram → merge pieces in an offscreen layer, cut only joint slits (`destination-out`), outline the whole figure.
A `clear()` that resets the transform silently kills the camera.
A figure fully hidden behind a letter reads as "nobody there" → let hat, nose and accent stick out. A stiff streamer reads as a tongue → multi-segment ribbon with a travelling sine.

case.title: 零点密码 · 60s 间谍片头风格样片（TREATMENT）

line.zh: 1930 年的大饭店，门童赶在午夜前把一封信送上顶楼。
line.en: A grand hotel, 1930: a bellboy races lifts and revolving doors to deliver one letter before midnight.

styles.essence: Black lacquer, engraved gold line and airbrushed geometry: a 1930s poster that moves.
pitfalls: Bulb signs from glyph skeletons break on curves (G, S, R): Zhang–Suen staircase pixels fool a neighbour-count junction test → use the **crossing number** and weld chain ends within ~14 px.
A generic cartoon character looks pasted in → characters are deco (§2).
Fish-scale reads as brickwork → lower half-circles row by row, each overlapping the previous row, plus an inner arc.

case.title: 《落成之夜》TREATMENT · 装饰艺术（Art Deco）风格样片

line.zh: 发明家的蓝图自己画出一台接云机器，修订云线变成了真的雨云。
line.en: An inventor's blueprint draws, explodes and assembles a cloud-catching machine, and its revision cloud starts to rain.

styles.essence: Engineering drawings that come alive on a sheet of cyanotype paper: white technical line work on Prussian blue, drawn in drafting order, with annotations that move.
pitfalls: **Main figure near the sheet edge** → wides show the desk. Keep margins or enlarge the sheet.
**Upward explosions hit the header** → explode sideways and flatten long parts during the explode.
**Subtitles on the ink buffer** vanish off-sheet and can't occlude lines → separate overlay, premultiplied alpha.

case.title: 19 · 蓝图 / 工程制图 ——《擒纵机构》

line.zh: 阳光从清晨移到黄昏，照到哪一格花窗，哪一格的故事就动起来。
line.en: Sunlight crosses a cathedral window from dawn to dusk, waking each pane of a knight-and-dragon tale.

styles.essence: A medieval stained-glass window seen from inside a dark stone hall, alive only where the sun touches it: light is the clock, the camera and the story.
pitfalls: Hidden leads show through front pieces → erase the surface under each piece before stroking its lead.
Pastel glass → hue-preserving tone mapping; darker flesh. Red dusk × blue glass = mud → keep blue alive, raise intensity.
Voronoi reads as a filter; flat fills read as clip-art → hand-cut lozenges, texture on every piece, heavy grisaille.

case.title: 浴火 · 彩色玻璃窗风格样片 TREATMENT

uses: Explainers told through signs and objects

line.zh: 一把被落在公交车上的黄伞，晴天里在失物招领的货架上等了一整天，暴雨回来时和另外 312 把一起撑开：物件、交通、天气和标识，都是卡着节拍的几何象形符号。
line.en: A yellow umbrella left on a bus waits out a sunny day on the lost-property shelf, then opens with 312 others when the storm comes back: objects, vehicles, weather and signs as beat-locked geometric pictograms.

styles.essence: A beat-locked film built from three things only: a **square-grid "core graphic"** of circles, half-discs and tiny patterned cells whose rows slide past each other; **geometric pictograms** (objects, vehicles, weather, signs, and a disc-headed figure when one is needed) made of round-capped bars, discs and capsules; and **bold bilingual type** that slides up out of masks.
pitfalls: Figure environments spread into the text column → render the figure layer into its own buffer and fade it out with a gradient mask before the text.
Cream on light hues fails contrast → dark type and dark figures on light hues; their disc is the lighter tone.
The sun disc vanishes on the dark neutral → use a lighter tone for it.

case.title: 一天 · ONE DAY — 象形运动图形样片 Treatment

line.zh: 月球基地的 AI 沉睡 40 年后被唤醒，用字符画出“家”来回复。
line.en: A moon-base AI wakes after forty years to a signal from Earth, and replies by drawing “home” in characters.

styles.essence: Everything on screen is a real character on a monospace grid, lit by the phosphor of an old monochrome CRT.
pitfalls: **Inverse video**: `destination-out` only changes alpha, which the upload ignores → opaque black canvas, cut letters with a *black* atlas.
**Negative not aligned to the grid** drifts across hundreds of columns → map with cell width / samples exactly.
**Wrong cell centre**: cells are 2·cw tall, so the centre is `(j + .5)·2cw`, not `(j + 1)·cw`.

case.title: whale.exe —— 处理方案（ASCII / CRT 终端）

line.zh: 一百年的夏季气温，图表本身就是故事。
line.en: A hundred years of summer temperatures, where the chart itself tells the story.

styles.essence: A chart that tells a story: real data, drawn mark by mark on cream paper by a red–blue pencil, with handwritten notes pinned to the numbers.
pitfalls: Select data columns by header name, never by index; print every fact the narration claims.
Notes collide with later data → data-space pins, a memory zone.
A frame break rescaled too fast is invisible → hold the pierced state ≥ half a beat.

case.title: 地球的一秒

line.zh: 一杯咖啡从种植园到你手里的旅程。
line.en: A coffee's journey from the plantation to your hands, across one isometric world.

styles.essence: A system diagram comes alive: an isometric diorama of flat three-tone blocks, thin ink labels and Isotype numbers, where things open up to show their insides and the numbers are drawn, not stated.
pitfalls: Newell normals depend on vertex order: faces get culled as back faces → give every face an outward hint and flip the normal to match before culling.
Painter sorting breaks on composites → draw them as one ordered item; add depth bias for overhangs.
Semi-transparent moving solids look like ghosts → motion only, no alpha.

case.title: 一封信的旅程 · 等距信息图 风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 虚构 app Tidy 的发布片：被埋掉的光标一键把几百个窗口归位。
line.en: Launch film for Tidy, a fictional app: one buried cursor snaps hundreds of windows back into place.

styles.essence: A software launch film where the interface itself is the star: near-black gradient, hairline grid, soft light, one brand accent, and UI that moves with snap-grid precision.
pitfalls: Strip perspective of a semi-transparent canvas shows vertical seams (overlapping slices double alpha) → project the *opaque* surface, then light it in screen space.
A hard white glint reads as a sticker reflection → soft front, glint ≤ 20 %.
Nearest-slot snapping looks like a flicker, not a collapse → typed destinations, curved paths, trails.

case.title: Lumen · 暗色科技发布 风格样片 —— 导演阐述

line.zh: 一只咖啡杯满厨房追一块逃跑的方糖。
line.en: A coffee cup chases a runaway sugar cube around the kitchen, 1930s-cartoon style.

styles.essence: Black-and-white hand-inked cartoons where every object is alive and swings to a hot jazz band.
pitfalls: **Flat grey frames.** Push backgrounds to mid grey, keep pure white and ink for characters, add a contrast boost.
**Wide shots kill gags**: a far shot makes characters tiny and Mickey-mousing unreadable. Use medium shots, and a packed medium-full for crowds.
"Sad" brows drawn as "angry": define brows by inner / outer end (inner = near the nose), not by left / right.

case.title: 闹钟起床号

line.zh: 快递少女骑车穿过雨后霓虹都市，赶在黎明发射前送到一盘磁带。
line.en: A courier girl rides through a rain-soaked neon city to deliver a tape before the dawn launch.

styles.essence: Hand-painted cel animation from the golden age of Japanese OVAs, re-created in code: flat two-tone cels over airbrushed backgrounds, backlit neon, limited-animation timing, played back as a late-80s videotape on a CRT television.
pitfalls: White cels bloom pink → bloom from the emissive canvas; weak, high-threshold bloom on colour.
Neon bleeds through characters → silhouettes stamped into the emissive canvas.
Black holes in highlights → clamp before S-curves.

case.title: 追电车的夏天

line.zh: 厌世天才开传送门只想买杯咖啡，却穿过越来越离谱的平行宇宙。
line.en: A jaded genius opens a portal just to buy coffee and tumbles through ever-stranger universes.

styles.essence: Adult-animation sci-fi sitcom: thick boiling outlines, flat colour, a duo whose reactions don't match, a glowing portal, and one palette per world.
pitfalls: TTS reads hyphen stutters as words: write syllables ("buh, buh-broken"); respell words it mangles; pick names that survive a low voice.
Whisper mis-hears very short clips unless padded with ~0.6 s of silence.
A real interruption: generate the interrupted line *longer* than needed and truncate the audio where the other voice cuts in.

case.title: 《冷冻柜》 TREATMENT

line.zh: 勇士在最终 Boss 门前存档，存档画面闪回一路冒险。
line.en: At the final boss door a hero saves the game, and the save screen replays the whole journey.

styles.essence: A short film that looks, sounds and *behaves* like a mid-90s console role-playing game: 320×180 pixels, a limited indexed palette, text boxes that type, menus, save files, chip music with echo.
pitfalls: Rank-based palette mapping crushes a scene to black → map by luminance with a gamma.
Reduced subsets without warm hues turn a sunset solid red → keep warm hues.
An 8-bit set without dark green or brown turns night grass blue; generic brightening near fire turns grass neon → warm remap.

case.title: 宝箱怪

line.zh: 灯塔熄灭，孙女提着最后一簇火穿过夜林、爬上风暴悬崖。
line.en: The lighthouse goes dark; a girl carries the last flame through a night forest and up the storm cliffs.

styles.essence: Hand-made pixel sprites standing like paper cut-outs inside a lit, fogged, fully 3D diorama, shot from a high three-quarter angle through a tilt-shift lens: a toy world where every lamp throws a real shadow.
pitfalls: **Checkerboard everywhere** → the dither band is too wide (≈ .22 on sprites, ≈ .45 on textures).
**A light burns out the sprite that holds it** → move the light ~0.45 m toward the camera; cap sprite lighting in the shader (`min(outgoingLight, diffuse * 1.35 + emissive)`).
**Lights behind a billboard don't light it** (front normal only) → always the front fill.

case.title: 港口集市 · 风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 见习宇航员闯五秒训练营，越来越快，Boss 关亲手降落回地球。
line.en: A clumsy cadet survives a five-second boot camp, faster and faster, until the boss: landing home.

styles.essence: A rapid-fire party-game film: one command word, a few seconds, one action.
pitfalls: **A luminance-ramp ASCII figure is mush** → hand-authored glyph art with structural glyphs, an inverse glyph for the accent.
**Ink shapes read as smoke** unless their silhouette is designed (a short round blot phase, then a clear structure with seams and light edges).
**A failure at high tempo goes unread** → make the action overshoot and hit something, or give it an instant replay.

case.title: 四连关

line.zh: 把 AI 发展史做成一局节奏游戏，模型踩着拍登场，最后发成绩单。
line.en: The history of AI as a rhythm game: models take the stage on the beat, and a report card closes the show.

styles.essence: A rhythm-game variety show in flat vector: toy-like mascots with thick ink outlines on candy-coloured stripes and sunbursts, every hit landing on a fixed tempo grid, call-and-response patterns, and a judgement word when each round is won.
pitfalls: **Stateful updates break parallel renders**: a worker starting cold shows the initial state. Recompute every pose from `t`; compare single stills with a sequential render.
**Cue lists drift** when cut flashes, jingles and arrangement are separate hand lists: derive them from one table.
**Fixed-length audio buffers** cut the tail: size them from the duration.

case.title: 节奏猜动物

line.zh: 面包店学徒追一个滚走的面包，最后掰成两半分给饿肚子的小女孩。
line.en: A baker's boy chases a runaway loaf downhill, then breaks it in half for a hungry girl.

styles.essence: An engraved-illustration silent film projected in a picture house: ink line and silver wash, a 4:3 print that flickers and weaves between velvet curtains, intertitles instead of voices, and a cinema pianist who plays every beat.
pitfalls: **Too much content kills a silent film**: a many-step chain at small figure scale is noise in a thumbnail. One legible chain with a pause in the middle beats three busy ones.

**Puppet arms**: apply abduction before flexion, let the shoulder rise and swing forward as the arm goes up, slim the torso's shoulder corner on the raised side, hide the arm's contour where it lies over the torso. Raise arms sideways (or turn the figure) so they don't cross the face.
**Pose pops**: drive every figure by eased keyframe lists, never by `if` branches.

case.title: 《追帽子》TREATMENT · 1920s 默片

line.zh: 新夜班员工拍下入职第一晚：无尽的黄色办公空间，和墙上的员工守则。
line.en: A new night-shift hire films their first night in an endless yellow office, following the rules on the wall.

styles.essence: Camcorder tapes recovered from empty, endless, fluorescent-lit spaces.
pitfalls: **A fully bright scene reads as a hospital corridor** → partitions with gaps; far areas fall dark.
**Lights leak through walls** (no occlusion) → a dead zone needs every light within ~±5 m dead, and the space behind it dim.
**Background shows as a bright rectangle** at a corridor's end → background = fog × ~0.15.

case.title: 《交接录像》TREATMENT（后室 / 新怪谈 · 风格样片 36）

line.zh: 积木宇航员用零件拼出火箭，飞向积木月亮。
line.en: A brick astronaut builds a rocket from spare parts and flies to a brick moon.

styles.essence: Stop-motion toy-brick films shot like macro photography on a real desk: a world built from interlocking plastic bricks with round studs, animated a pose at a time.
pitfalls: Tungsten HDRI → orange whites. Use a neutral studio HDRI and a slightly cool grade.
Clearcoat on a large flat baseplate reflects softboxes as a coloured wash. Make it matte.
Flat, slightly jagged first renders: even light, no AO, single-sample rendering, stepped camera. Fix: softboxes + low environment, GTAO, 2× supersampling, cool grade, camera on ones.

case.title: 37 · 积木玩具《积木小屋变船》— 导演阐述

line.zh: 立体书在书桌上打开，小精灵 Pip 在纸片世界冒险，最后跳出书外。
line.en: A pop-up book opens on a desk; a sprite named Pip adventures through paper worlds and jumps out into ours.

styles.essence: A pop-up book on a real desk becomes a stage: flat cut-paper actors with white borders perform in front of paper sets that spring up from the page, under real lamp light and a real macro lens.
pitfalls: `rotation.y` shows a card edge-on, then its blank back → `scale.x` flip. Negative scale also swaps front/back materials → draw mirrored props instead.
A one-plane container hides its contents → back card + front card, contents between.
Near-lens foreground pop-ups fill the frame with blur → move them or close the aperture.

case.title: 《纸龙》TREATMENT

line.zh: 玩具城的早高峰，一切都像模型。
line.en: Morning rush hour in a town that looks like a model: traffic, trains and tiny people.

styles.essence: A real-looking place photographed from high above with a tilted lens and a time-lapse camera, so the whole world reads as a tabletop model.
pitfalls: Tall buildings plus shallow pitch hide the ground → low to mid-rise buildings, pitch 45°+.
The subject hides in a canyon or behind a facade → route it on the camera side and let the band follow it.
Instance caps silently drop actors → cull by distance from the camera (≈ 4× camera height) and raise the cap.

case.title: 港口一日

line.zh: 空海里一格格长出小岛和村庄，每放一块响一个音符，直到星空。
line.en: An island and its village grow tile by tile from an empty sea, each tile a note, into a starry night.

styles.essence: A tiny faceted world seen through an orthographic isometric lens: everything is a geometric block, and everything that appears arrives with a bounce and a note.
pitfalls: `perspectiveDepthToViewZ` in shared post code is wrong for an orthographic camera → `orthographicDepthToViewZ`.
GTAO renders sprites and transparent objects as solid quads → hide them during the AO pass; set `visible = false` at zero opacity.
Side column and top cap sharing one plane → z-fighting → sink the column.

case.title: 风车的一天

line.zh: 虚构玻璃耳机 Aura 的开箱与特写。
line.en: Unboxing and close-ups of Aura, fictional glass earbuds, in strip-light sweeps and caustics.

styles.essence: Launch-film product rendering in transparent and frosted glass: a dark-field studio, strip-light sweeps, dispersion, caustics, light travelling inside the object, slow exploded views that snap shut on a downbeat.
pitfalls: A manually updated mirror uses last frame's camera → call `scene.updateMatrixWorld(); camera.updateMatrixWorld()` first; the transmission pre-pass re-renders it → no-op its `onBeforeRender`, update once per frame.

A coloured emitter inside frosted glass tints the whole object; idle glow under a lens dome becomes a pale blob; AgX turns accents white; frosted glass on black is black; mirror chrome becomes a white disc → the rules in §2–§3.
An exploded view seen perpendicular to its axis is edge-on lines → axis ~40° to camera.

case.title: 棱光 PRISM：处理方案

line.zh: 公园只是一张钢笔速写，风把草帽吹到哪里，哪里才有颜色。
line.en: A park that is only a pen sketch; wherever the wind carries her straw hat, colour follows.

styles.essence: A sketchbook page drawn on location: fine sepia fineliner lines that wobble, overshoot and never quite close, with loose transparent watercolour dropped on top.
pitfalls: **Straight edges in the colour field** from clipping by a bounding box → clip by the actual noisy distance.
**Rectangular masks around complex silhouettes** leave notches → mask with the real stepped silhouette.
**Characters losing colour** when they move into unpainted areas → sample arrival once (or tie it to the event), never at the current position.

case.title: 早餐铺开门 · 钢笔淡彩风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 像素小人 Clawd 搬进 Claude 应用，一镜到底演示 Plan 模式和自检。
line.en: Clawd hops out of the terminal into the Claude app and acts out plan mode and self-checks in one take.

styles.essence: A product walkthrough that looks like a real screen recording, where a low-resolution mascot lives inside a high-resolution interface and acts out what the software is doing.
pitfalls: Invented features or renamed modes → check every button, mode and shortcut against the product's documentation; if it isn't in the docs, it isn't in the film.
The mascot floats or drifts off its element → measure the DOM every frame, stand only on top edges.
The mascot covers text or sits under a caption → reserve a text-free lane for it.

case.title: 《逃跑的周报》处理方案（活体实机录屏 · 风格样片）

line.zh: 用 50 年代教育片的口吻，三步教你装好一台扫地机。
line.en: A robot vacuum set up in three steps, told like a 1950s classroom film.

styles.essence: 1950s flat colour and limited animation for "follow along" films: colour printed a few pixels off its broken ink line, bodies that hold still while hands do the work, abstract colour-block rooms, a calm classroom narrator, and a cool-jazz combo.
pitfalls: A route that ignores obstacles → follow the product's real rules; flow streamlines bend around obstacles and never cross. Lay it one region per beat, not all at once.
A separate nose wedge looks glued on → one open spline from the bridge round the skull, closed at the nose tip.
Thin arms read as sticks from the neck → shoulders at the torso corners, sleeves as a thick ink ribbon with a colour ribbon on top.

case.title: 明日早晨

line.zh: 电助力车被扫描成全息线框，目标框依次锁定电池、电机、刹车。
line.en: An e-bike is scanned into a hologram; target boxes lock onto the battery, motor and brakes.

styles.essence: An object is scanned into a glowing wireframe.
pitfalls: Target boxes balloon → rest pose, skip `internal` pieces, long attachments `box:false`.
Long diagonal leaders point at the wrong part → ring on the part body, flash the part.
Two parallel boxes moving don't read as an explode → shell slides on its axis, contents stay and glow.

case.title: 52 · 科幻全息界面《种子扫描》— 导演阐述

line.zh: 一张博物志图版自己刻出来：雕刀推开铜版，蜜蜂一线线成形，最后手工水彩上色。
line.en: A natural-history plate engraves itself: the burin cuts the copper, the bee builds up line by line, and a watercolour wash brings it to life.

styles.essence: An intaglio plate that engraves itself: a burin cuts swelling lines into copper, a proof is pulled, and the figure builds up — outline, hatching, cross-hatching — until engraved lettering, magnified details and a hand-laid wash make a finished plate.
pitfalls: Uniform width reads as pen → swell hatches, pinch contours between runs (`hatch({swell})`, `outline({run, pinch})`), keep wMin hair-fine.
Overlaps without occlusion → pass occluders as `excl` (subtracted ring by ring; even-odd would cancel overlaps).
Outline-only parts beside a hatched body → hatch along each part's axis, a dark at every joint.

case.title: 博物志·鹦鹉螺 · 铜版画风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 一张满屏丝印海报一座城，票根数着离家的公里数，走到世界的另一头，才发现那是回家的路。
line.en: A traveller crosses the world one full-bleed screen print at a time, a ticket stub counting the distance from home, until the far side turns into the way back.

styles.essence: Opaque, hard-edged flat inks pulled one colour at a time through a screen: 4–6 inks per poster, stepped colour bands instead of gradients, thin paper-white gaps where the registration slips.
pitfalls: Stroke edge effects draw internal lines on unioned paths → fills only (fill, then fill shifted inside a clip).
A full-rectangle screen shadow muddies the print → ring shadow.
Cool shadow facets next to water read as water → shadows in the near ink.

case.title: 岛屿之光 · 丝印旅行海报（风格样片 54）

line.zh: 卫星照着地图去找咸海，找到的是沙漠；只有筑了坝的那一块回来了。
line.en: A satellite follows the map to the Aral Sea and finds a desert; only the part someone dammed came back.

styles.essence: Real satellite imagery of a real place, graded down to an analyst's grey, with thin white measurement lines drawn on the ground: a lock-on reticle, outlines, a range line, one reading.
pitfalls: **Licences**: not usable: Google Earth/Maps, Bing, Esri World Imagery, Mapbox Satellite, Planet, Maxar, news photos, AI-generated imagery. EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless is CC BY 4.0 only for 2016 (2018 onward is NC). Raw Copernicus Sentinel data need "Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data [year]"; check the user's rules. Public domain or free with credit: USGS Landsat (1972 on, worldwide), USGS NAIP (US, ~1 m), NASA Blue Marble, MODIS, VIIRS. Burn a readable credit into the picture and list every asset in `CREDITS`.

**Finding imagery for a new place**: search by bounding box and date in the Planetary Computer STAC (Landsat C2, Sentinel-2 L2A; no account) or USGS EarthExplorer; MODIS/VIIRS and Blue Marble from NASA GIBS; coastlines, lakes and rivers from Natural Earth (borders and China: DIRECTOR.md §13). Log every request. OSM (ODbL), CC BY-SA and "no known restrictions" are not CC0: name the terms and ask the user first. Ask for the user's own surveys or GIS layers when the place is theirs. Never fill a gap with generated imagery presented as evidence.
**Seams**: paths imaged on other days disagree. One date per path, each scene gain-matched on stable land, feathered overlaps, holes filled from the same year only.

case.title: 后退的冰川

line.zh: 一条河要架桥，四种桥型在一面简报墙上逐个受检，拍板的是桥下要过的船。
line.en: Four bridge types are tested on one briefing wall, and the ship that must pass under picks the winner.

styles.essence: One real whiteboard wall, filmed: window light on enamel, ghosts of erased marker, frame and tray.
pitfalls: **Text glimpsed in passing** fails the reading time. Fix: words where the camera rests; frame each new item with the last result.
**Only close-ups.** The viewer never sees the whole object against the limit. Fix: detail → judgement frame → hold → verdict → move on.
**Photos that don't belong together.** Fix: one grade, one light vector, one viewpoint family.

case.title: 悬索桥为何不倒

line.zh: 激光点云剥掉一片森林的树冠，露出当年农田的石墙：3.4 公里。
line.en: A laser survey strips the canopy off a Connecticut forest and finds 3.4 km of old farm walls.

styles.essence: Real airborne laser points of a real place, floating in the dark as a measured cloud; a scan line or a cutting plane passes through them and the points condense into a solid, raking-lit surface, which is then measured with hairline instruments.
pitfalls: **Finding data for a new place**: USGS 3DEP (US) as Entwine Point Tiles per project at `https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/usgs-lidar-public/<project>/ept.json`, projects and footprints in `boundaries/resources.geojson` of github.com/hobuinc/usgs-lidar; bare-earth scouting through the 3DEP elevation ImageServer. OpenTopography (catalogue of many collections, licence per dataset). AHN (Netherlands, CC0). National portals, e.g. England's Environment Agency LiDAR (OGL), France IGN LiDAR HD (Licence Ouverte), Spain PNOA-LiDAR (CC BY 4.0), Finland NLS (CC BY 4.0), New Zealand LINZ (CC BY 4.0); read each portal's terms. Fetch a subset by box and depth, not whole tiles.

**Licences**: public domain, CC0, CC BY and attribution-only government licences are fine, with credit in `CREDITS`. ODbL, CC BY-SA, "no known restrictions" (not CC0) or non-commercial terms: name them to the user and ask first. Never commercial scans or Google 3D tiles. Ask the user for their own scans (a site survey, a drone or terrestrial scan, their BIM) when the film is about their asset. Never stand in a generated or invented cloud for real evidence.
**Facts**: keep a FACTS.md in the project folder (claim, source URL, quoted wording, or the measurement method) and deliver it with the film.

case.title: 火山口

line.zh: 投影机把数据一层层刷上鹿特丹白模：从 1940 年的空洞到今天的塔楼。
line.en: A projector paints Rotterdam's white model layer by layer, from the 1940 gap to today's towers.

styles.essence: A pure white massing model of a real place stands on a plinth in a dark room, and a projector paints data onto it as light: one layer at a time, falling on the surfaces that face it, spilling a little past the plate.
pitfalls: **Wall normals** wound the wrong way show inside faces (walls look hollow): derive the outward normal from ring orientation. **Shared walls** between parts z-fight: skip the overlap below the lower neighbour.
**Warm HDRIs turn the white model beige**: use a neutral studio environment.
**GTAO on wide grazing views** produces wedge-shaped dark bands; keep it on close shots only.

case.title: 涨潮一米

line.zh: 十二年风电和太阳能装机叠成实物，绕表盘升成两条螺旋，2021 年太阳能反超。
line.en: Twelve years of wind and solar stacked as real plates, spiralling round a walnut dial until solar overtakes.

styles.essence: Real statistics built as real objects: every unit is a countable piece of material (a plate, a block, a coin, a bar) stacked to exact scale on a crafted base, shot like a product in a studio — soft key, long shadows, shallow depth of field, physically based materials.
pitfalls: Two materials too alike (bright aluminium vs clear acrylic) read as one series: give one a tint or a finish change, and check at thumbnail size.
Long shadows and warm reflections turn metal brown at distance: add a cool rim light and keep the base darker than the pieces.
Thin pieces moiré at 2–3 px per layer: random per-piece value and offset, 2× supersampling.

case.title: 一年的雨 · 处理方案（Treatment）

line.zh: 开源键盘的一半在一次环绕中逐层拆开，看到主控再合拢，标上真实尺寸。
line.en: Half an open-source keyboard comes apart in one orbit, down to the chip, then closes with its real dimensions.

styles.essence: A real product, built from its own engineering files (CAD, PCB layout, bill of materials), lit like a studio packshot and taken apart in front of the camera: the layers lift on one axis, the camera travels between them, every part is named with the numbers its files contain, and it closes again into one object.
pitfalls: **Invented numbers.** A size that no file gives. Fix: measure it from the CAD and say "measured" in the facts file, or leave it out.
**Mixed-up revisions.** Plates, cases and boards from different versions of a project. Fix: check hole positions and stack heights across the files (they must coincide), and pin the commit.
**Panelised boards.** Layout files may hold a panel with breakaway tabs. Fix: take the outline from a plate or case of the same revision, or flood-fill from an interior point.

case.title: 按一下

line.zh: 一镜从肝组织玻片推到单个细胞核，两个圆逐像素数出 2.4 倍的蓝。
line.en: One continuous move from a liver slide to a single nucleus; two circles, counted pixel by pixel, differ 2.4 times in blue.

styles.essence: Real, licence-clean microscopy of a real specimen, seen as it is, and one continuous change of scale that carries the viewer from the glass slide in the hand to a single cell.
pitfalls: **Licences**: most microscopy on the web is CC BY-NC or all rights reserved. Usable: CC0 whole-slide scans (e.g. the OpenSlide test data: check each file's licence line), public-domain government micrographs (NIH, CDC PHIL, NASA, USGS), CC BY collections (Cell Image Library, Wellcome Collection), with every file listed in `CREDITS`. Not usable: CC BY-SA without agreement, NC images, journal figures, AI images.

**Finding material for a new topic**: search by organ, stain or material plus "whole slide" in the OpenSlide test data, NCI Imaging Data Commons (TCGA/CPTAC slides, licence per collection), the Cell Image Library, Wellcome Collection, Wikimedia Commons (filter by licence) and NIH/CDC galleries; prefer a file whose metadata carries its pixel size. CC BY-SA, ODbL or "no known restrictions" are not CC0: name the terms to the user and ask before using them. For a product, a lab or a brand, ask the user for their own scans (SVS/NDPI/MRXS, SEM TIFFs with a scale) first. Never stand in a generated image for a real specimen.
**Different samples never zoom into each other**: two micrographs of "the same thing" at two scales are two specimens. Use one pyramid; if you must join sources, cut on a focus breath and say so.

case.title: 一滴池塘水

line.zh: 电报说最长飞了 57 秒；放大镜下，莱特兄弟的底片和档案说是 59 秒。
line.en: The telegram said 57 seconds; under a loupe, the Wrights' glass negatives and the archive say 59.

styles.essence: Real archive objects (glass negatives, slides, letters, telegrams, clippings, drawings) lie on a cool, backlit light table.
pitfalls: **Over-magnifying a weak scan**: keep the lens interior under about 1.5 screen px per scan px; choose items by scan size.
**The loupe sweeping over empty table**: lay objects close together, land the loupe straight onto the object (drop in, don't slide in), and glide the camera over objects, not gaps.

**Shear in the photograph space**: one depth map for a photo with people or machines in it tears them apart. Cut upright subjects into layers, fill behind them, and keep 2.5D moves small enough that the fill is barely seen.

case.title: 十二秒 · 档案灯台（Archive Light Table）风格样片

line.zh: 美国一年死掉 130 万箱蜜蜂，总数却涨了 6%：静音也能看懂的新闻。
line.en: America lost 1.3 million bee colonies, yet the count rose 6 %: a news short that works with the sound off.

styles.essence: Social-video news that reads with the sound off.

case.title: 会用工具的海獭

line.zh: 1926 年报纸说查尔斯顿会跳坏膝盖，福特工人野餐会上的孩子照跳不误。
line.en: 1926: the papers say the Charleston will ruin America's knees; at Ford's own picnic the kids dance it anyway.

styles.essence: A sound newsreel of the late 1920s, cut from real archive material: a searchlight-and-globe ident with a brass fanfare, a newspaper that spins into the lens, a fast and cheerful announcer on an optical soundtrack, place-and-date cards, maps, magazine pages and documents, wipes, flips and irises, and a hot band that can stop dead for the punchline.

case.title: 64 · 1920s 新闻影片 ·《空中竞速》TREATMENT

line.zh: 阿尔忒弥斯二号发射的最后一分钟，一秒不剪：格子从 1 开到 9，点火合成 1。
line.en: The last minute of the Artemis II launch, uncut: one cell opens to nine, and they merge into one at ignition.

styles.essence: An edit style, not a look.
pitfalls: **Unsyncable footage** (an edited "rover" reel with no clock or event to align on). Never fake it: label the cell "same window · not frame-synced", keep it out of the countdown's key seconds or use it only where nothing it shows contradicts the time, and say so in `FACTS.md`. Look first for a source with a burned-in timer, a visible ignition / flash / whistle, or the same audio.

**Measuring zero.** Never trust metadata. Combine two independent marks: a visible event (ignition flash, a broadcast countdown bug's flip) and the spoken word timing ("booster" at zero). Re-measure on the file you actually cut: `ffmpeg -ss … -c copy` starts on the previous keyframe.
**Audio and picture of one file can disagree** (a switched feed whose audio lagged its video by ~1 s). Sync each camera on its picture.

case.title: T−15 · 实时倒计时分屏 — 导演阐述

line.zh: 纽约的一天：延时光河、踩着十六分音符的网格，1899 年和今天并排。
line.en: One day in New York in time-lapse: rivers of light, a grid on the sixteenths, 1899 beside today.

styles.essence: A city film cut like a piece of minimalist music: time-lapse turns traffic, crowds and clouds into rivers of light, the cuts get denser with the score's subdivisions, one thing is slowed almost to a stop, and the film ends on a hard cut to black on a downbeat.
pitfalls: **Watermarks and slates hidden in CC footage**: corner logos (scale from the centre until they leave frame, within 1.5×), opening thank-you cards, end-card music credits, title text over the first shots. Check a 1-second contact sheet (`tools/secsheet.py`) of every source before choosing in-points.

**Hidden cuts inside sources.** Hyperlapse reels hide 2–3-frame jump cuts and whip transitions; frame blending across a cut makes ghosts. Scan with `ffmpeg … select='gt(scene,0.25)',showinfo` and keep every clip's source window inside one shot.
**Too much blending** turns noon clouds into grey mush: about 40 % shutter (24 of 60 frames) looks better than 100 %.

case.title: 城市的一天

line.zh: 新闻片、照片、证词和调查报告排上同一条时间轴，五路来源指向一处。
line.en: Newsreel, photos, testimony and the 1937 inquiry on one clock: five sources point to the same spot.

styles.essence: A cold investigation desk: footage, photographs, documents, sound and maps from one real event, laid out on one shared clock so they check each other.
pitfalls: **Inference passed off as fact.** Camera positions, photo times and offsets need `≈ / inferred / unlocated` on screen and in `FACTS.md`.
**Early reports as facts.** The first-night memo and the period newsreel often disagree with the final report; use them as images or as claims to check, never as the source of a number.
**Faking a multi-camera event.** With one licensable film, do not borrow clips of unclear origin; cross-check film + photos + documents + sound instead. The structure still holds.

case.title: 大桥的五十九分钟

line.zh: 帝国大厦的小册子写着建造者，工地实拍和老照片给出答案：每天 2,500 人。
line.en: The Empire State's 1931 brochure credits its builders; the site film and Hine's photos answer: 2,500 a day.

styles.essence: Real archive footage, photographs and documents, printed as one ink-and-paper poster with a single red, and cut on a machine beat.

case.title: 《大坝》TREATMENT · 构成主义蒙太奇（kino-montage）

line.zh: 半场 0–3，费内巴切 12 分钟连进三球：冻住画面、画线、分屏、射门图。
line.en: Down 3–0 at half-time, Fenerbahçe scored three in 12 minutes: freeze, draw, split screen, shot map.

styles.essence: The TV football analysis segment: play the clip at full speed, rewind, freeze it, and draw on the broadcast picture — rings under players' feet, marker arrows for the ball, a red patch for the space nobody covered — then play on, switch angles, count the frames, and flatten the pitch into a board.

case.title: 《那一脚》 TREATMENT — 体育战术板 Sports Telestrator

line.zh: 一周四条 AI 新闻，一整套电视台包装：串联单、标题条、翻牌价格表、规格卡。
line.en: Four AI stories from one week in a full on-air package: rundown, headline strap, price board, spec card.

styles.essence: A television newsroom's on-air package, built entirely in code: a sting that becomes the channel bug, a rundown of today's stories that opens and closes the bulletin, a lower-third strap that never leaves the bottom of the frame, and full-frame graphics (split-flap price boards, a line breaking a threshold, explainer maps, documents flying out of a city, quote cards, spec cards with proportion bars, stamps) that carry the facts.

case.title: 《本周天气》 · 电视新闻包装 风格样片（19.75 s）

line.zh: 一个河湾一镜过完四季，大树一蹲一弹，就换一季。
line.en: One river bend, four seasons, one take; each turns when the big tree squats and springs back.

styles.essence: A place built as a tabletop model: on warm white paper an organic, grainy frame grows open, and inside it a small world in flat Memphis colours, ink outlines, hard purple shadows and tiny patterns, full of small motions under a slow camera.

case.title: 冰淇淋车

line.zh: 一张纸上的线路图，从 1993 年的 6 公里长到 21 条线、906 公里。
line.en: A printed metro map grows from one 6 km line in 1993 to 21 lines and 906 km.

styles.essence: A metro schematic printed on a physical sheet: lines held to eight directions, white stops, black-outlined interchange capsules, water as a flat blue band.
pitfalls: **Off-grid geometry**: any segment not at 0/45/90° breaks the style. Route between points with an automatic bend (straight then diagonal, or the reverse) and validate every segment.

**Labels over lines, or labels that jump**: give labels a paper halo and place them once against the finished network, before the first frame. Placing against what is drawn so far makes labels hop as lines arrive.
**Parallel lines sharing a corridor** collide: offset each line by ±0.10 G and let one capsule enclose all points of the station.

case.title: 十年 · TEN YEARS — 地铁线路图风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 粉笔写下网上的说法，再一擦，把「射」写回三千年前。
line.en: Chalk writes a popular claim about two characters, wipes it, and traces 射 back three thousand years.

styles.essence: A real classroom blackboard on which chalk writes itself, stroke by stroke in true stroke order, with no hand, no chalk stick and no eraser in sight.
pitfalls: Dirty boards (old swirls, ghosts, floating dust) read as "messy", not "real". Keep the slate clean and let the grain carry the realism.
Equal-width polylines look like a plotter and make characters misread. Use stroke-type width and pressure profiles.
Character data that is structurally wrong is caught at once by native readers: check every character against a reference before shooting.

case.title: 三个正方形 —— 黑板粉笔 · 风格样片 73

line.zh: 等距的登机口和机舱里，小人按顺序登机，讲清哪种叫法快将近一半。
line.en: Travellers board an isometric plane, and the order shows why one way is nearly twice as fast.

styles.essence: A calm explainer of an everyday rule, set in one real place drawn in true isometric with flat colour: small faceless people seen from behind do the thing in order, while serif type lands on the ground, character by character, as if painted there.
pitfalls: Anything raised by H metres hides what lies behind it (toward −x behind a face that looks +x, toward −y behind a face that looks +y): floor up to H metres back from a long edge, and a person standing there loses everything below the edge's top, vanishing completely within H − 1.7 m. It holds for low objects too: a 0.8 m belt or counter covers floor type 0.8 m behind it, a 3.2 m truck side hides people's legs up to 3.2 m behind it and whole people within 1.5 m, a glass wall or a wing hides type metres away. Keep type and the people who matter on the camera side of tall objects, or cut those objects down; check every frame in which a vehicle passes.

A path that zigzags (turning at every vehicle or doorway) reads as noise; routes run along the world axes with few right-angle turns, and the walker or vehicle on them heads away from the camera (see the back-view pitfall below).
A crowd folded into a serpentine reads as a solid block; one straight line reads as order. Numbers on the floor beside each person need spacing wide enough for the label (about 1 m).

case.title: 面包店的早晨

line.zh: 刮版画的北海道河谷一镜到底，丹顶鹤从 33 只数回到 1,927 只。
line.en: Red-crowned cranes in a Hokkaido valley, one scratchboard take, counted back from 33 to 1,927.

styles.essence: A three-dimensional world rendered as a scratchboard print, ink and paper with one red, crossed by one unbroken camera move.
pitfalls: **Close-ups expose the flat shading.** 3D props pushed close to the lens look like toys. Keep living subjects to mid shot as flat silhouettes; give close props real materials (carved wood, concrete formwork, cast iron).
**Empty paper.** A field of snow without layers goes blank. Keep three layers in frame; add drift strokes, reed ticks, thickets, belts.
**Grey sludge.** Fine cuts at distance average to grey; fade them to solid ink or paper with distance and use negative mip bias for thin sprites.

case.title: 雪夜小站 · 印刷长镜头 风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 江河变成电路板上的走线，电流从水坝跑 2,080 公里进手机充电器。
line.en: Rivers become copper traces as current runs 2,080 km from a dam to a phone charger.

styles.essence: The subject is drawn as a printed circuit board seen from straight above: the world is copper under green solder mask, routes are traces, places are pads, words are white silkscreen, and what flows (power, water, signals, goods) is light running along the copper.
pitfalls: **Flat pour.** A board that is all mid-green reads as an empty slide. Fill with real board texture: stitching vias that stay visible at map scale, fences along every clearance, mottling, micro silk, other unlit routes that exist in the subject.
**Decorative routing.** Traces that mean nothing make viewers ask what they are. Draw only real routes; texture comes from vias and mask, not invented traces.
**Lines crossing on one layer.** Two traces can't cross on the same copper: use a via to the bottom layer, or route around. A trace may cross a bare channel (a river, a street).

case.title: 《叮咚》TREATMENT · 电路板风格样片

line.zh: 一张猫照片跳过桌上的应用卡片，从一台手机飞到朋友手机里，一镜跟到底。
line.en: A cat photo hops across app cards on a sunlit desk, from one phone to a friend's.

styles.essence: App screens and tools lie on a sunlit desk as printed paper cards; small pixel characters, popped up into voxel toys, carry the work from card to card, while one unbroken camera flies after them, whips between stops and finally pulls back over the whole desk.
pitfalls: **Softness**: depth of field and motion blur easily turn a subject or its words to mush. Blur only what lies behind a focus plane set a little beyond the subject, lightly (≤ 5 px), never anything in front; let the shutter shrink with camera speed so a streak never exceeds about 8 px; draw card and screen canvases at 3–3.4× (pills at 3×) so print stays crisp when a card fills the frame; no CSS or canvas blur on anything meant to be read.
**Flat print read at a low angle**: text on a card seen from 20° is unreadable. Rise to 55–70° to read a card; put text the low camera must read on a standing object.
**A standing toy hides the row behind it**: place characters beside or behind the text being read, or off the card, and check every reading frame for overlap.

case.title: 灵感送达 — 桌面穿梭 · 风格样片 TREATMENT

line.zh: 先用蓝铅笔起稿，再描线、铺水彩，一秒重画 12 张。镜头一动才发现，整幅画是立体的。

styles.essence: 铅笔起稿、水彩晕染、一拍二 12fps

line.zh: 一座悬浮的小城：道路自己画出来，楼房一圈圈弹起，车在跑、云影在走。太阳落山，窗户和路灯一盏盏亮起。

styles.essence: 正交投影、昼夜光影、镜头环绕

line.zh: 一镜到底的无限推进：手里的手机→屏幕里的城市→亮灯的窗→房间里的电脑→剪辑软件里，又是那只手。

styles.essence: 无限缩放、矢量插画、无缝循环

line.zh: 九百根金色细线像丝绸一样随风飘，再排成连绵的山脊。镜头向前滑行，太阳升起，一束光沿山路走到最远的山顶。

styles.essence: 九百根线、透视山脊、镜头滑行

line.zh: 粉彩摄影棚里，糖果方块落下搭成领奖台，金环像欧拉盘一样转着落定，玻璃珠滚过，镜面球最后登顶。

styles.essence: 光线步进、玻璃折射焦散、景深

line.zh: 七千个光点在三维空间里漂浮，一次次变形：想法→灯泡→作品→播放键→爆款，每次都卷起一阵气流。

styles.essence: 7000 粒子、旋度噪声、弹性落定

line.zh: 切割垫上，一张张模切贴纸啪地贴下：白边、反光、落下时收紧的影子。马克笔箭头串起步骤，讲清一条视频怎么火。

styles.essence: 模切贴纸、反光扫过、镜头巡游

line.zh: 无人机飞进一座激光雷达点云城市，扫描波一圈圈点亮街区。全套飞行 HUD：罗盘、高度速度带、雷达，最后锁定一辆飞车。

styles.essence: LiDAR 点云、飞行 HUD、目标锁定

line.zh: 牛皮纸上一张张撕下、剪好、贴上：杂志字、网点印刷、拍立得、压纹标签和红印章。最后夕阳带着树影扫过桌面。

styles.essence: 撕纸纤维、真实光影、定格 12fps

name.zh: 弥散渐变 · 玻璃拟态

line.zh: 极光弥散渐变做锁屏，玻璃卡片从药丸里长出来，一颗玻璃球掠过时钟，真实地折射、放大、色散。

styles.essence: 折射色散、SDF 融合、液态玻璃

line.zh: 二十块上漆的胶合板悬在白色影棚里，像一组抽象雕塑。镜头绕到唯一的那个角度，所有碎片严丝合缝，拼成一张包豪斯海报。

styles.essence: 错觉对齐、光线追踪、120 BPM

line.zh: 贴着霓虹山谷低飞：发光网格、条纹落日、棕榈掠过。铬金大字和霓虹手写体砸进来，整帧再过一遍录像带。

styles.essence: 光线步进地形、VHS 后期、霓虹光晕

line.zh: 304×171 的画布，每个像素都由代码摆放：抖动渐变、色彩循环瀑布、提灯照亮森林，推门通关。

styles.essence: 抖动渐变、色彩循环、视差卷轴

line.zh: 一滴液态金属落进暗场：皇冠水花、融合、升起，最后凝成一枚镜面播放键。

styles.essence: 光线步进、液态金属、高速慢放

line.zh: 多层描边、拟声字、表情贴纸、卡点推镜和闪白，把一颗煎蛋拍成综艺名场面。

styles.essence: 多层描边、拟声字、卡点推镜

line.zh: 把真实的剪辑软件拆成悬浮图层，景深在层间切换；光标点下「AI 一键成片」，素材飞上时间线，镜头推进监视器。

styles.essence: CSS 3D 图层、景深切换、光标演示

line.zh: 一整版排好的报纸专题：衬线大标题、双栏正文、自己画出来的折线图、数字滚动和荧光笔。镜头像读者的视线一样游走。

styles.essence: 真实排版、图表生长、镜头阅读

line.zh: 一滴墨落在宣纸上晕成远山，再落笔松石与渔舟，镜头推进画里，最后钤上朱印「肖雄」。

styles.essence: 墨晕扩散、宣纸纹理、朱印落款

line.zh: 三团彩泥揉成一只小知更鸟，每秒 12 帧定格，指纹和手作的抖动都留在画面里。

styles.essence: 定格 12fps、彩泥质感、微距景深

line.zh: 一支播客麦克风的爆炸图：轮廓线、尺寸标注和引线跟着零件走；零件组装好，扫描线一过，图纸变成真实的产品。

styles.essence: 爆炸视图、尺寸标注、图纸变实物
